title: BLUMFI
tagline: A platform offering blockchain-based courses and credentials for lifelong skills.
description: Rossmarie is bringing underbanked women onchain through verifiable education and community. Our app uses World ID for secure identity, EAS  and NFTs for onchain reputation w/ token gated access. Yellow Network unlocks the future: walletless onboarding, fiat support, and zk-powered access. Today, we reward verified learners. Tomorrow, we bank and teach finance to the unbanked.
how_its_made:
ERC-721 NFT-Grants token-gated access (ownership required)
World ID-Proves user uniqueness via Worldcoin and Mini App
EAS (Attestation)-Verifies that the user has a valid on-chain attestation (e.g., enrolled or verified)
Yellow Network-(TBD) for fiat onboarding (e.g., buy NFT or pay with a card without wallet)
